design: Industrial software: neutral surfaces, clear typography, standard tables, readable full dates and named primary actions.

screens.name: Sources
screens.purpose: Retain original files, typed exports and all editions

screens.name: Accounts and sites
screens.purpose: Inspect original client/site relationships and label history

screens.name: Accreditations and scope
screens.purpose: Inspect selected published records and complete scope qualifiers

screens.name: Assessments and documents
screens.purpose: Preserve native cases and source-owned document relationships

screens.name: Billing
screens.purpose: Reconcile rate, unit, account, period and credit lineage

screens.name: Receiving
screens.purpose: Compare actual returned target data with the selected sources

screens.name: Handover
screens.purpose: Deliver a complete editable programme to Voco’s team

source_rules.assessment_schedule: Receive programme-specific schedule and original case dates; the published AS1 typical cycle remains a selectable source profile.
source_rules.finding_dates: Receive actual agreed deadlines from original case records.
source_rules.transition_dates: Preserve source date precision and issued standard; proposed transition planning remains distinct from an issued decision.
source_rules.fees: Use selected original fee edition and received finance rules.
source_rules.document_access: Map source roles to the commissioned target access model.

operating_sequence: Receive complete original source and target metadata
Save reviewed mappings and source decisions
Export and independently reopen complete handover
